row:
We are proud to be a part of Advocate Health, headquartered in Charlotte, and the fifth-largest nonprofit health system, serving nearly 6 million patients across six states.  

Atrium Health Floyd provides a full spectrum of health care services from prenatal childbirth classes to grief support groups through Heyman Hospice Care at Floyd. More than 2,000 babies are born at Atrium Health Floyd Medical Center each year and are cared for in one of our three nurseries, including a neonatal intensive care nursery for babies as small as two pounds. 

People are at the center of everything we do. We are committed to our patients, our co-workers and our community, and we are committed to exceeding your expectations.
